pageProps.title: Baden-Württemberg Ettlingen Big Flower Postcard
pageProps.review: Location of the Baden-Württemberg Ettlingen Big Flower Postcard. The address is Neuwiesenrebenstraße 33, Ettlingen, Landkreis Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg. If it doesn't appear alone, turn on the detector and move around the area.
pageProps.content: ```adcard ``` Around autumn in October 2026, here is Baden-Württemberg Ettlingen Big Flower Postcard. Totoro holding an umbrella fills the wall, sparkling with blue triangles. It has a sharp kind of cuteness, distinct from the fluffy feel of the original work. From the bottom corner, a Pikmin holding a flower looks up at Totoro. It’s a postcard that would be even more delightful to come across in an alley on a rainy day. ```adcard ```
